channelNotLinked.detail: Launch the Activity from your session voice channel. Current Discord channel ID: {{channelId}}. Register it in DynamoDB (seed-handshake-channel script). “Launch in DM” does not use the voice channel.

voiceChannelRequired.detail: Start the Activity while you are in the game voice channel (current ID: {{channelId}}). Direct messages are not supported.
